With Anthony, your Real Estate journey is not just a transaction; it's an adventure. Experience the Houses of Kansas City difference, where passion meets proficiency, and every deal is sealed with a touch of fun. Contact him today so he can guide you through the buying and selling process. Work with Anthony Home Search
FROM THE SITE
What "luxury" means in Kansas City
Luxury real estate here isn't just a price point. It's homes with real architectural character, properties with history, land with development potential, and buyers and sellers who want an agent who understands what makes a property actually stand out, not just what it's listed for. That's the market I work in every day: Mission Hills, Leawood, Prairie Village, Fairway, Overland Park, Brookside, and the wider Kansas City metro on both sides of the state line.
FROM THE SITE
What Makes the Shakespeare Chateau Singular
Most historic homes have been compromised. Original windows replaced. Period details painted over or removed entirely. The Shakespeare Chateau is the exception that makes you realize how rare genuine architectural integrity actually is. 47 original stained-glass windows. Every single one installed in 1885 and still present.
FROM THE SITE
Frequently Asked Questions

Meet Anthony West: Kansas City's Trusted Real Estate Advisor

YOUR INTRODUCTION
Anthony West leads Houses of Kansas City at Sage Sotheby’s International Realty, guiding clients with proven strategy and a seamless, personable style. With 13 years of experience and a $34M+ sales record, his approach centers on intelligent marketing, in-depth local knowledge, and a high degree of care for each client. Licensed in Kansas, Missouri, and California, Anthony connects sellers and buyers across Mission Hills, Leawood, Prairie Village, and the entire KC metro. His digital reach ensures that every listing stands out in today’s market, while personal dedication guarantees a process that’s as smooth and rewarding as possible.
